# @sonora/api-schema

The API contract. `openapi.json` is exported from the FastAPI app
(`services/api/scripts/export_openapi.py`); a test in the API suite fails if it is stale.

* `src/schema.gen.ts` — types generated by `openapi-typescript` (`pnpm generate`; `pnpm build`
  fails if it is out of date).
* `src/index.ts` — `createSonoraClient()`: an `openapi-fetch` client with bearer auth, a single
  shared refresh on `token_expired`, and `SonoraApiError` for the unified error envelope.

```ts
const api = createSonoraClient({ baseUrl, getAccessToken, refreshAccessToken });
const { data, error } = await api.GET("/v1/tracks/{track_id}", { params: { path: { track_id } } });
```

The Kotlin client for Android is generated from the same file in the Android phase
(see ROADMAP.md).
